How We Work

Read this before you trust anything above

What we do

We code verified Canadian reviews by hand and cross-check every listing figure. Every claim on this site carries its source label.

What we have not done

We have not finished bench testing. Where a measured value belongs, we write "Not yet tested" instead of estimating it.

How we get paid

We earn commission when you buy through our links. Commission rates are never an input to a ranking, and we say which brands cannot buy placement.
